title: Jobs (functions)
instructions: A function is a job with a name. You write it once and use it as many times as you like.
int add(int a, int b) means: a job called add, it needs two whole numbers, and it hands back a whole number.
return hands the answer back to whoever asked.
task: Finish the add job so the program prints:  2 + 3 = 5
hint:
Hand back the sum:

    return a + b;
